datasets.title: CoCliCo - Global Coastal Transect System (GCTS)
datasets.description: Cross-shore coastal transects are essential to coastal monitoring, offering a consistent reference line to measure coastal change, while providing a robust foundation to map coastal characteristics and derive coastal statistics thereof. The Global Coastal Transect System consists of more than 11 million cross-shore coastal transects uniformly spaced at 100-m intervals alongshore, for all OpenStreetMap coastlines that are longer than 5 kilometers. The dataset is more extensively described Calkoen et al., 2024. 'Enabling Coastal Analytics at Planetary Scale' available here (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envsoft.2024.106257). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the STAC catalog coclico (https://www.openearth.nl/coclico-workbench/data_catalog/)]
